title: BreakGuard: Towards Detecting Dependency Breaking Changes with LLM-Generated Tests
abstract: arXiv:2608.20167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-source libraries play an important role in software development by providing reusable features that expedite the development process. As libraries evolve, they release new versions that add features, fix bugs, or apply security patches. In this process, they may break the contract established with their clients by introducing breaking changes (BCs) that alter the runtime behavior and break client applications. Client-side test suites often fail to detect these BCs because of limited library coverage that does not exercise all library methods used in the client's codebase.   We propose BreakGuard, an approach that generates a test suite to detect breaking changes in clients. BreakGuard statically extracts every client method (focal method) that invokes the target library method (call site), then generates tests per focal method. translated_title: BreakGuard：利用大语言模型生成的测试检测依赖破坏性变更
translated_abstract: 开源库在软件开发中扮演着重要角色，通过提供可复用的功能来加速开发过程。随着库的演进，它们会发布新版本以添加功能、修复错误或应用安全补丁。在此过程中，它们可能通过引入破坏性变更（BCs）来破坏与客户端建立的契约，这些变更会改变运行时行为并破坏客户端应用程序。由于库覆盖率有限，客户端测试套件往往无法检测到这些破坏性变更，因为它们没有覆盖客户端代码库中使用的所有库方法。我们提出了BreakGuard，一种生成测试套件以检测客户端中破坏性变更的方法。BreakGuard静态提取每个调用目标库方法（调用点）的客户端方法（焦点方法），然后为每个焦点方法生成测试。如果测试在破坏前版本上通过而在破坏版本上失败，则该测试检测到破坏性变更。我们进行了评估...
tldr: 本文提出BreakGuard，利用大语言模型为客户端焦点方法生成测试，通过对比破坏前后版本的行为差异来有效检测依赖库的破坏性变更。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BreakGuard, which leverages LLMs to generate tests for client focal methods, effectively detecting dependency breaking changes by comparing behavior across pre- and post-breaking versions.
